title: Combined Window and Door Permit Filings — Installation Jobs
content:
**Combined filings and permit amendments — Installation Jobs**

The filing share of a permitted **Installation Jobs** record depends on whether the customer's other contract shares the filing. The other contract is a contract of the other product: an **Entry & Patio Door Contracts** contract for a window job, or a **Window Replacement Contracts** contract for a door job, that has been released to the factory and not yet installed (its contract status is ordered).

| The customer's other contract | Filing | Filing share paid by this job |
|---|---|---|
| held, released to the factory and not yet installed, and signed within 30 days of the contract this job installs | both jobs go on one combined filing | 0.6 |
| held, released to the factory and not yet installed, and signed more than 30 days apart from the contract this job installs | added as a permit amendment | 0.8 |
| no such contract held | — | one |

The 30 days are counted between the signed date of the contract this job installs and the signed date of the other contract, whichever was signed first. The permit administration fee figure of the job is multiplied once by the filing share, as a whole.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical signed dates)

| This job's contract signed | Other contract signed | Days apart | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 April | 1 May | 30 | 0.6 |
| 1 April | 2 May | 31 | 0.8 |
| 15 May | 1 April | 44 | 0.8 |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A window job's permit administration fee figure before the share is 150.00, and the customer holds a door contract with status ordered, signed 12 days after the window contract. The share is 0.6, and 150.00 multiplied by 0.6 gives 90.00.
